title: Read a query value
summary: Flask: Read a query value. Visit /search with no query.
introduction: request.args reads query-string values. Open GET /search?q=cat.
learningObjectives: Read a query value with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Read a query value

blocks.text: request.args.get reads q and finds cat. The returned dictionary names it term.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Query values are text unless you convert them.
